answer: An agent economy resists sybils by anchoring each identity to a deterministic root of trust minted once per hardware enclave, so a single physical host cannot spawn unlimited personas across the ocean of participants. Colluding accounts must post a bonded stake verified through a sovereign clearinghouse, making each fake identity a costly pearl rather than a free oasis of. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
